label: Pig identification and traceability
description: Pig, swine, hog, and boar identification using slap marks, ear tags, tattoos, herd marks, RFID tags, and electronic movement systems. Covers movement licensing, biosecurity, welfare, farm assurance, and disease control including African Swine Fever, Classical Swine Fever, and swine influenza.
exclusions: guinea pigs as pets unless animal health context
